transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I'm just having some trouble, I guess. With food. It's like... once I start eating, I just kind of disappear. Something else takes over. And... even when I'm telling myself to stop, I just keep going. Until I can't stand it anymore.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?

Yeah... um. Usually. After it happens, I just... I'll find a bathroom in my dorm, or maybe a quiet floor in the library. I just... I get really freaked out that all of it is just sitting there, turning into weight. So... yeah. I do.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah... um, I guess so. 

Like... I can be having a decent day in class, but... if I catch my reflection in a window at the dorms, and I think my stomach or my face looks bigger than the guys around me... I don't know. 

It just feels like I failed. Like I failed at everything. I just... I don't want anyone to see me after that.
Do you often limit the amount or type of food you eat?
Um... I don't know. Not really, I guess. I just kind of... eat whatever's around. I haven't really thought about it like that.
How often do these episodes of eating until you can't stand it anymore happen?

Um... I don't know the exact number. A lot, I guess. 

Most of this semester, it's... it's been happening a few times a week. The eating, and then the... throwing up. It's not just a once-in-a-while thing anymore. For the last few months, at least, there hasn't really been a week where it stopped. It's just... kind of constant right now.
Do you think your weight is normal?
Um... I don't really know what's normal. I just... I don't like how I look. I don't really weigh myself that much, so... I don't know.
Do you think there's something wrong with your body shape or size?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean... I'll be having an okay day, you know, going to classes and whatever. But then... if I see myself in a window or something... and I think my stomach or my face looks bigger than the other guys... it just ruins it. It feels like... I don't know, like I failed at everything. I just want to hide and not let anyone look at me.
Have you noticed your weight going up and down a lot over the past few months?
Um... I don't really know. Like I said, I don't weigh myself much, so... I haven't really been keeping track.
Have you noticed that your clothes fit differently from one time to another?
Um... not really. I mostly just wear... like, big hoodies and sweatpants anyway. So... I haven't really noticed them fitting any different.
Have you had any periods where you lost a lot of weight, followed by periods where you gained it back?
Um... no, I don't think so. Like I was saying before... I don't really check my weight or anything. So... I wouldn't really know.
Have you ever lost a significant amount of weight at any point in your life?
Um... no. Not that I can remember. I just... I don't really pay attention to that kind of stuff, so... probably not.
Do you exercise a lot to try to burn off calories after you eat?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I don't... I don't really exercise much at all, honestly.
Do you think there's something wrong with your appearance even when others tell you that you look fine?

Um... I don't know. I guess... I mean, I can be having a decent day in my classes, but... if I catch my reflection in a dorm window or something, and I just... I think my stomach or my face looks bigger than the guys around me... it just feels like I failed at everything. And I just... I don't want anyone to see me after that. So... yeah, I guess.
Is your fear of gaining weight related to the idea of being overweight in general, or is it more about how your body looks?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess... I haven't really thought about it like that. They just kind of seem like the same thing to me. I don't know.
Is your fear of gaining weight more about the number on the scale or how your body looks in general?
Um... I don't really weigh myself much. So... I guess it's not the number. It's just... how I look. I don't know.
Is your fear of gaining weight because you think it will make you look unattractive, or is it because you're afraid of being overweight in general?
I... I don't really know. Like I said, it just... it all kind of feels like the same thing to me. I just don't want to look... bad, I guess. I'm not really sure how to answer that.
Is your fear of gaining weight mostly because you think it will affect how you look to others?

I guess... yeah, maybe. I mean... I can be having an okay day, like in my classes or whatever, but... if I walk past a window at the dorms and catch my reflection... and I think my stomach or my face looks bigger than the other guys around me... it just kind of ruins it. It feels like I failed at everything. I just... I don't want anyone to see me after that.
Do you think you would still be afraid of gaining weight if nobody could see your body?
I... I don't know. I've never really thought about it like that. I guess... probably? I'm not sure.
Would you still feel the need to vomit after eating if you didn't think it would affect how you look?
I don't really know. I guess... I mean, I don't think I would want to do it if I didn't care about how I looked. But... it's hard to separate the two in my head.
Do you have a specific weight in mind that you're trying to maintain?
I don't know... not really an exact number, I guess. Just... not more than I am now.
